statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
